evidence_quotes.quote: HIV/AIDS meeting the challenge World Health Organization Regional Office for South-East Asia New Delhi 2004
HIV/AIDS has assumed epidemic proportions in most parts of the South-East Asia Region, which now accounts for the second highest burden of the disease after Sub-Saharan Africa.
This revised edition of the advocacy booklet brings together the experiences and successes in tackling the current HIV/AIDS epidemic, as well as the new challenges ahead.
